This '''pear and almond smoothie''' is simple and vegan. It contains no added refined sugar.

==Ingredients==
*2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] unsweetened [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]]-flavored [[Cookbook:Almond Milk|almond milk]]
*1 large, ripe [[Cookbook:Pear|D'Anjou pear]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon wedge]]

==Procedure==
#Cut the pear into chunks, discarding the core. Place the chunks of pear in a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]].
#Squeeze the juice of the lemon over the pear.
#Add the almond milk. Blend. Serve immediately

== Notes and Variations ==

* If you add [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]] and/or [[Cookbook:Nutmeg|nutmeg]] to this, it can act as a vegan substitute for eggnog—however, it is not as thick as traditional eggnog.
